'''Chapter 199''' is titled "Hope!!".

==Cover Page==
[[Hatchan's Sea-Floor Stroll]], Vol. 15: "Reunion With Dear Old Friends".

Despite apprehensions from [[Camie]] and [[Pappag]], [[Hatchan]] embraces [[Macro]] and [[Macro Pirates|his gang]] as long-time comrades.

==Short Summary==
[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Pell]] are able to catch [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] who is falling down to her death. Retrieved by her friends, who arrives safely one by one, she can retrieve faith in herself. Luffy can then face [[Crocodile]] again, full of energy and with a new trump card on his back: a barrel full of water.

==Long Summary==
[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Pell]] manage to catch [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] in the air, who was falling to her death. Vivi tearfully tells Luffy that the main regiment soldiers were beaten, the central square will be blown up, and that she cannot save her country, while Luffy comforts her, telling her that her voice reached [[Straw Hat Pirates|them]] just fine. [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and [[Nami]], both injured from their fights, are seen running toward the plaza, Zoro carrying Nami despite his more serious injuries. Landing in front of the palace, Pell tells Luffy to be careful, and Luffy replies that he won't lose anymore, after eating a ton of meat and his blood is surging. [[Usopp]], [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]], [[Sanji]], Zoro and Nami, all noticing that Luffy has returned, all arrive at the front of the palace, while Vivi expresses relief that they are all okay. Nami knocks Usopp to the ground for giving her so much trouble, asking him why would she think she would want a "toy for parties". Usopp tells Chopper to bury his body in the wilderness, while Sanji confronts Zoro for letting Nami get injured. Luffy, apologizing to his crew for losing, tells them that it's time to change everything, pulling himself to the palace rooftop to confront [[Crocodile]].

As Crocodile reminds Luffy that he cannot be touched, Luffy manages to land a punch on the [[Seven Warlords of the Sea|Warlord]], knocking a surprised Crocodile back while Luffy grabs him and uses '''Gomu Gomu no Buzzsaw'''. [[Nefertari Cobra|Cobra]] is surprised that Luffy could hit Crocodile when so many others couldn't, while [[Nico Robin|Miss All Sunday]] is shown to be visibly impressed. Crocodile then realizes how Luffy is able to touch him, pointing out that the giant barrel Luffy is carrying on his back is full of water. Luffy recalls that in their first confrontation, he was able to grab Crocodile's arm when it was covered with water, and deduces that due to water being Crocodile's weakness, that is the reason why he stole [[Arabasta]]'s rain. Squirting more water onto his fists, Luffy prepares to fight, telling Crocodile their fight is only just beginning.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] all rendezvous with each other, along with [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] and [[Pell]], in front of the palace.
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] has discovered [[Crocodile]]'s weakness, which is water, as Crocodile cannot turn into sand when in contact with water.
**This marks the first time Crocodile is shown to be successfully attacked.
**Luffy is able to touch Crocodile and attack him as long as one of them are in contact with water.
